verdict.rationale: GA4 itself documents exporting all raw events to BigQuery, with continuous intra-day export, and provides first-party links to Google Ads and other Google advertising tools. Onward delivery is limited to Google-owned destinations, and getting data from BigQuery to external storage is a BigQuery capability, not a GA4 one. Missing for 10: forwarding to third-party CRMs or non-Google ad platforms, registrable outbound webhooks, true per-event streaming to arbitrary destinations, and detail beyond a resource name for how events flow through the Google Ads link.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform

citations.quote: You can export all of your raw events from Google Analytics properties ... to BigQuery
